limitations: This is a static Open XML audit; it does not prove visual balance, overflow, overlap, or rendered contrast
Table roles follow the Starter Guide example: row 1 is the column-header row and column 1 contains row headings
Bullet detection uses explicit bullet XML or paragraph levels above zero; unusual master-only bullet definitions can be missed
Placeholder inheritance is resolved through the slide layout and master, but SmartArt, OLE objects, and formatting inside linked workbooks are not expanded
Raster-image pixels are not color-audited; only the PowerPoint picture frame and its effective outline are checked
An explicit DrawingML line with no width attribute is interpreted as PowerPoint's 0.75 pt default

raw_finding.message: Slide contains p:timing animation XML; the Starter Guide says to use separate build slides

accepted_media_playback_exception.reason: The user explicitly requested three embedded videos on one slide. The timing tree contains only parallel video playback and targets exactly those three movies; no shape animation or transition is present.
